AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted KUA Donorojo administrator registry record.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the KUA administrator.

email.description: Verified Google email of the KUA administrator.

displayName.description: Full display name of the KUA administrator.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

role.description: Role of the signed-in Google account.

StaffAccount.title: StaffAccount
StaffAccount.description: Username and hashed password credentials for Admin KUA Donorojo, Penghulu KUA, and Modin Desa.

localId.description: Stable local staff account ID (e.g., admin_kua, modin_blingoh, penghulu_kua_1).

villageId.description: Assigned village slug ID for Modin accounts, empty for Admin/Penghulu.

villageName.description: Display name of the assigned village or KUA Donorojo.

whatsappNumber.description: WhatsApp phone number for Smart Reminder.

googleEmail.description: Optional lowercased Google email for cross-device officer sync.

active.description: Whether this login account is currently active.

waliHakimAuthorized.description: Whether this Penghulu is authorized as Wali Hakim.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the KUA workspace owner.

ReminderSettings.title: ReminderSettings
ReminderSettings.description: Smart Reminder, Kepala KUA signature, and Wali Hakim default configuration managed by Admin KUA.

remindOneDayBefore.description: Send reminder on H-1 before wedding day.

remindThreeDaysBefore.description: Send reminder on H-3 before wedding day.

reminderTime.description: Preferred daily reminder time in HH:mm WIB format.

adminWhatsappNumber.description: Official Admin KUA WhatsApp sender number.

headOfKuaTitle.description: Official signer title for A4 monthly report.

headOfKuaName.description: Official Kepala KUA name for A4 monthly report.

defaultWaliHakimAccountId.description: Default Penghulu account ID for Wali Hakim.

allowedReaderEmails.description: Bounded list (max 25) of authorized Modin/Penghulu emails for read sync.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the KUA workspace owner.

Village.title: Village

modinEmail.description: Optional lowercased Google email of the Modin.

allowedReaderEmails.description: Bounded list (max 25) of authorized staff emails.

createdByUid.description: UID of the KUA workspace owner.

MarriageSchedule.title: MarriageSchedule
MarriageSchedule.description: Marriage registration, N1-N4 document checklist, Wali Nikah data, and akad nikah schedule synced real-time.

groomName.description: Full name of the prospective groom.

groomNik.description: Optional NIK of the prospective groom.

brideName.description: Full name of the prospective bride.

brideNik.description: Optional NIK of the prospective bride.

weddingDate.description: Scheduled akad date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

weddingTime.description: Scheduled akad time in HH:mm 24-hour WIB format.

validationStatus.description: Validation status set by Admin KUA.

documentsComplete.description: Whether required N1-N4 documents are complete.

verifiedByName.description: Name of Admin KUA officer who performed verification.

allowedMemberEmails.description: Bounded list (max 15) of authorized Modin/Penghulu emails.

createdByUid.description: UID of the KUA workspace owner who created the record.
